description: Input template for the selected electroweak local determinant response. Fill only with spectra selected before electroweak comparison.

mode_schema.eigenvalue: positive selected eigenvalue of the gauge-factor Laplace/Dirac/threshold operator
mode_schema.multiplicity: selected multiplicity, default allowed by calculator is 1.0

no_knob_rules: Eigenvalues, multiplicities, and index weights must come from selected topology, flux, boundary conditions, or operator spectra.
The table may not be tuned to reproduce lambda_12, sin^2(theta_W), alpha_EM, or measured gauge couplings.
Universal trace shifts are allowed but do not affect lambda_12.
The calculator is deterministic accounting, not a source of spectral data.
